conventions.kappa: odd central element, kappa^2 = 0, written on the left: [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa*gamma(X,Y)
conventions.gamma_decomposition: gamma(X,Y) = gamma_ad(X,Y) + gamma_scalar(X,Y)*1 with gamma_ad in g (adjoint module) and gamma_scalar in C (trivial module)
conventions.f_parametrisation: f(Z_j) = sum_i phi[i][j] Z_i + c[j]*1  (phi odd: nonzero only for p(Z_i) != p(Z_j))
conventions.linearity: gamma, gamma_scalar, phi, c are linear in gb; the tables are given per unit gb parameter

untwisting_map.description: a~^sigma = a^sigma + kappa*m^sigma, m^sigma = sum_j (gb[a^sigma,b_j-] b_j+ - gb[a^sigma,b_j+] b_j-); b unchanged. Phi: U(A) -> U(A'), a -> a~, b -> b is an isomorphism; Phi(Z) = Z + kappa*Phi_1(Z).
untwisting_map.f_definition: f := -Phi_1, split into g-part phi and scalar part c

symmetrized_section.description: odd generators represented by (1/2)(a b + b a) = b a + (1/2) gb kappa; brackets recomputed directly in U(A') and re-expressed in this basis
